subject: PO onboarding constraints & tiered-discount application for HealthCo
messages:

Subject: Vendor PO requirements and discount/ invoicing cadence

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the demo last week — HealthCo is excited about Redwood's predictability for inference spend. Procurement asked me to confirm a few things so we can start drafting a PO:

- Our ERP (Coupa) requires a PO header per legal entity; can Redwood accept a single master PO that references multiple BU line items, or do you need separate POs per entity to apply tiered discounts?
- Net terms: what flexibility do you have on Net30/Net60/Net90 for enterprise commitments? Finance is pushing Net60 but we can consider Net45 with preauthorization.
- Invoice cadence: we prefer consolidated monthly invoices per parent company rather than many small invoices per PO. Is that acceptable?
- Does Redwood apply SKU/usage discounts on the invoice level or do discounts need to be captured in the PO metadata?

I attached HealthCo's standard PO template for reference (HealthCo_PO_template.pdf). Please cc our billing contact Sophie Lane (sophie.lane@healthco.com) on replies.

Appreciate any concrete guidance so we can map the PO fields cleanly.

Best,
Oliver
Director, Strategic Sourcing
HealthCo Systems

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com>

Subject: Re: Vendor PO requirements and discount/ invoicing cadence

Hi Oliver — thanks for the clear list and for sending the template. Answers below and a couple of asks so our billing team can map fields to your ERP cleanly.

1) PO per legal entity vs master PO
- Redwood can accept a single master PO that references multiple BU line items, but to *apply tiered volume discounts* we need either:
  a) separate PO numbers per legal entity (preferred), or
  b) a master PO with explicit per-entity line items and the "legal_entity_id" field filled for each line.
- If your Coupa instance cannot populate per-line legal_entity_id, we will treat the master PO as one bucket for invoicing and discounts will be evaluated against the aggregated usage for that PO number.

2) Net terms
- Standard: Net45.
- For enterprise commitments with multi-quarter SOWs we can move to Net60 (Finance approval required) or Net30 with an onboarding credit applied to the first invoice.

3) Invoice cadence
- We support consolidated monthly invoices by parent company. For multi-entity POs we can either issue:
  • consolidated invoice with line-level legal_entity breakdown (preferred for your ERP), or
  • separate per-entity invoices if you need them separated on receipt.

4) Discount application
- Discounts are applied at invoice level and seeded from the PO metadata. Practically this means the PO must include the discount tier (e.g., "VolumeTier=Silver/Gold/Platinum") or the per-line quantity thresholds. Without that metadata we default to baseline pricing and reconcile discounts at month-end (this can delay credits).

Next steps from our side: I attached our Redwood_PO_Guidelines_v2.pdf with the exact field names we need (legal_entity_id, billing_contact_email, cost_center, discount_code). Also attached a Sample_Consolidated_Invoice_Month1.xlsx so you can see the format.

Can you confirm whether HealthCo can populate per-line legal_entity_id in Coupa? If not, we should agree on a monthly reconciliation cadence and whether you want the first invoice to include an onboarding credit to offset Net60.

CCing Marissa from finance so she can pre-authorize Net60 for the RDW-HEALTH-2026-Q3-42 deal if you confirm estimated quarterly volume.

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

Quick note from ops/finance perspective — looping in here so we don't slow procurement:

- If HealthCo cannot provide per-line legal_entity_id, propose the following compromise to preserve discount eligibility:
  1) HealthCo issues a single master PO referencing three BU line items. In the PR comments of the PO they must list the legal entity IDs and cost centers explicitly (coupa: PO_comments field).
  2) Redwood will accept the master PO and *apply discounts* based on aggregated usage for that PO for the quarter, provided the PO_comments map is present.
  3) Invoices will be consolidated monthly. Any discount shortfall or over-credit will be reconciled at quarter close and adjusted on the first invoice of the following month.

- As an incentive, we can offer an onboarding credit equal to 8% of the first month's estimated spend if HealthCo signs the master PO and commits to the quarterly minimum of $150k. This is a one-time credit, not stackable with other promotional credits.

Marissa — can you provisionally approve Net60 for this deal if they accept the onboarding credit?

Oliver — if that path works, we'll provide a single DocuSign envelope with the PO acceptance + billing annex and a small addendum describing the quarterly reconciliation flow.

-Vivek
Director, Customer Finance
Redwood Inference
